title: Combined tracking area updating procedure initiation

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the UE to update tracking area and location area information, used when UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state and operating in CS/PS mode 1 or 2.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate the combined tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: EPS update type
entities.description: IE indicating the type of update, set to 'combined TA/LA updating' or 'combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach' in specific cases.

entities.name: UE radio capability information update needed
entities.description: IE included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST when UE radio capability changes.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by UE after sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST and starting timer T3430.

entities.name: T3430
entities.description: Timer started when UE initiates combined tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Current TAI not in registered TA list
entities.description: Condition triggering TAU when UE detects current TAI is not in previously registered tracking area list.

entities.name: UE radio capability change
entities.description: Condition triggering TAU when UE changes radio capability for E-UTRAN, GERAN, cdma2000, or NG-RAN.

entities.name: TIN set to P-TMSI
entities.description: UE behavior to set TIN to 'P-TMSI' before initiating TAU in specific cases.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST contains EPS update type IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST contains UE radio capability information update needed IE when radio capability changes.
Procedure initiation requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
Procedure causes UE to enter EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED state.
Condition triggers initiation of combined tracking area updating procedure.
Radio capability change condition requires inclusion of UE radio capability information update needed IE.
Radio capability change condition triggers initiation of combined tracking area updating procedure.
UE sets TIN to P-TMSI before initiating TAU in specific cases.
